messages.content: We decided the Wednesday flight is worth the extra night after all. Can you switch us and book the airport hotel we looked at?

Yes. American 2367 is still available Wednesday, November 26, from ORD at 8:05 p.m. to SEA at 10:38 p.m. for Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee. The Sunday United 2216 return at 1:20 p.m. can remain unchanged. Before I complete it, I’ll verify the revised airfare and hotel terms together.
Please do. Make sure the room allows all three of us and that arriving around midnight won’t be a problem.

The revised flights total $1,748 for all three travelers, including one checked bag each way. That is $121 more than the current booking. The Coast Gateway Hotel has a room with two queen beds for Wednesday night at $214.36 including taxes. Occupancy is three, late check-in is permitted, and the desk is staffed overnight. The hotel asks that arrivals after 11:00 p.m. be noted on the reservation.
And the names are correct on both the flights and room?

Yes. The flight record lists Marcus Lee, Daniel Lee, and Owen Lee exactly as stored. The hotel’s primary guest will be Marcus Lee, with Daniel Lee and Owen Lee added as occupants. I’ll note an expected arrival between 11:45 p.m. and 12:15 a.m.
Good. Complete both with the payment method on file.

The flight change and hotel booking are ready for final authorization: $121 additional airfare and $214.36 for the room, for $335.36 charged now. The Sunday return remains United 2216, SEA 1:20 p.m. to ORD 7:18 p.m. Shall I submit both charges?
Yes, submit them, and give me the Thursday morning transportation plan too.

Completed. American confirmation R4K8VN covers Marcus, Daniel, and Owen on flight 2367, Wednesday, November 26, ORD 8:05 p.m. to SEA 10:38 p.m. United confirmation H7LM2Q remains active for flight 2216 on Sunday, November 30, SEA 1:20 p.m. to ORD 7:18 p.m. Total airfare is now $1,748, including one checked bag each way. Coast Gateway Hotel confirmation CGH-730194 is for one room with two queen beds, three guests, November 26-27, at $214.36; late arrival is noted. After baggage claim Wednesday, take the hotel shuttle from the courtesy-vehicle pickup area. Thursday morning, take the shuttle back to SEA around 8:30 a.m., then request a rideshare to the relatives’ home; expected arrival is about 9:45 to 10:00 a.m., depending on traffic.
